title: [Bug]: OAI AMF SCTP File Descriptor Exhaustion Leads to Out-of-Bounds Access and DoS
body:
> AI Assistant: ChatGPT 6, Qwen3.8-Max
### Summary
An remote denial-of-service vulnerability exists in the OAI CN5G AMF N2 SCTP interface. By repeatedly establishing SCTP associations with the AMF, an attacker can cause accepted socket file descriptors to accumulate until the descriptor value reaches or exceeds the range supported by `fd_set`. The AMF subsequently passes the descriptor to `FD_SET()` without validating it against `FD_SETSIZE`, triggering a buffer overflow detection and terminating the AMF process.

### Step to Reproduce
- Start the OAI CN5G core network using `oaisoftwarealliance/oai-amf:v2.2.1`.
https://github.com/hackeryounow/5gc-deployments/blob/main/oai/2.2.1/docker-compose-basic-nrf.yaml
- Confirm that the AMF N2 SCTP interface on port `38412` is listening and accessible.
- Run [`poc_amf_sctp_fdset.py`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hackeryounow/5GCVulDB/refs/heads/main/CVE-2026-117067/poc_amf_sctp_fdset.py) against the AMF N2 interface to repeatedly establish SCTP associations without authentication.
`python3 ./poc_amf_sctp_fdset.py --target <AMF_IP> --mode hold --count 1200`
- Continue establishing associations until the AMF file descriptor value reaches the `FD_SETSIZE` boundary.
- Observe that the AMF terminates with a buffer overflow error and the N2 interface becomes unavailable.

## Logs

```sh
[2026-09-17 11:06:05.021] [amf_app] [debug] The gNB's info has been successfully updated!
[2026-09-17 11:06:05.021] [amf_n2] [debug] Remove gNB with association id 2070, gnb_id 0x0
[2026-09-17 11:06:05.021] [amf_app] [info] 
|----------------------------------------------------------------------gNBs' Information---------------------------------------------------------------------|
   |  Index |               Status               |              Global Id             |              gNB Name              |                PLMN                |
   |    1   |            Disconnected            |                0x00                |                                    |                  ,                 |
   |    2   |            Disconnected            |              0x0ADEAD              |                                    |               208,95               |
   |------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

   |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
   |---------------------------------------------------------------------UEs' Information----------------------------------------------------------------------|
   |  Index |     5GMM State     |                IMSI/SUPI               |        GUTI        |   RAN UE NGAP ID   |   AMF UE NGAP ID   |        PLMN        |       Cell Id      |
   |    1   |  5GMM-DEREGISTERED |             208950000000031            |                    |        0x01        |        0x04        |       208,95       |      000000010     |
   |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

*** buffer overflow detected ***: terminated
```

## Affected Versions
Tested Image: `oaisoftwarealliance/oai-amf:v2.2.1`
### Impact
Successful exploitation terminates the AMF process and makes the N2/NGAP control-plane interface unavailable. Existing gNB associations are lost, UEs served by the affected AMF become unreachable, and procedures such as registration, paging, handover, and session management can no longer be processed.

CVSS 4.0：`CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:A/VC:H/VI:L/VA:H/SC:L/SI:H/SA:H`
